content.label: Collections
content.doc: Internet Archive collection identifiers to browse, separated by commas or new lines. Identifiers are case-sensitive (e.g. NYCTaper, not nyctaper). Examples: aadamjacobs, pearljambootlegs, NYCTaper, taperssection, etree

content.label: Results Limit
content.doc: Maximum number of shows to display when listing an artist's concerts for a year (default: 100)

content.label: Artist Index Threshold
content.doc: Collections larger than this many items show an A–Z letter index before the artist list, instead of loading every artist at once (default: 4000)
